## 1. Professional Summary & Architectural Philosophy
Suyash Sharma is a Full-Stack Engineer and Systems Architect based in Delhi, India. His work centers on high-performance web applications, local-first computing, offline AI search engines, and scalable backend platforms. 

Core principles:
- **Zero-Cloud / Privacy-First Compute**: Building offline-capable AI search tools and image processing engines that execute entirely on the user's hardware without leaking data to cloud endpoints.
- **Performance & Precision**: Handcrafted responsive UIs with sub-100ms interaction latencies, clean CSS architecture, semantic HTML5, and strict WCAG accessibility.
- **Architectural Rigor**: Scalable database modeling, strict TypeScript typing, deterministic state machines, and resilient API contracts.

---

## 2. Core Technical Competencies

### Frontend & Web Architecture
- **Frameworks**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components, Route Handlers, Streaming SSR), React 19, React Router
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), HTML5, CSS3 / Modern Vanilla CSS
- **Animation & Graphics**: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), ScrollTrigger, Canvas API
- **State & Data Fetching**: Zustand, React Query / TanStack Query, Server Actions

### Backend & Database Systems
- **Runtimes & Frameworks**: Node.js, Express, Laravel (PHP), Django (Python)
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Neon Serverless Postgres, SQLite
- **ORMs & Query Builders**: Drizzle ORM, Prisma, Django ORM, Eloquent
- **Security & Auth**: Supabase Auth, Row-Level Security (RLS), RBAC, JWT, CSRF protection

### Systems Engineering & AI
- **Languages**: Rust, C++, Python
- **Desktop & Native Platforms**: Tauri, Electron
- **Machine Learning & Search**: ONNX Runtime, BM25 Keyword Search, Vector Embeddings, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), Local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- **Media Processing**: Sharp C++ Engine, libvips, WebP/AVIF compression

### CMS & eCommerce Platforms
- **WordPress**: Custom theme development from scratch, PHP template hierarchy, custom post types (CPT), ACF, REST API integrations, performance tuning.
- **Shopify**: Custom Liquid themes, Shopify Plus, Storefront API, app integrations.

## 3. Production Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Glint (2026) — AI / Hybrid Search Engine
- **Role**: Solo Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, Rust, Tauri, ONNX, React, RAG, Vector Search, BM25
- **Source**: https://github.com/SuyashSharma1710/glint
- **Overview**: Ultra-fast private hybrid search engine & Raycast-grade spotlight for codebases. Combines BM25 keyword search with ONNX vector embeddings using Reciprocal Rank Fusion, running entirely locally without sending data to external cloud APIs.

### 2. PixelSpace (2026) — Local Desktop Image Processor
- **Role**: Solo Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: Electron, React, JavaScript, C++, Sharp, WebP, AVIF
- **Source**: https://github.com/SuyashSharma1710/PixelSpace
- **Overview**: High-performance local-first Electron desktop application that optimizes heavy images into modern WebP and AVIF formats using an embedded C++ processing engine via Sharp.

### 3. Pitchery (2026) — Startup Discovery & Pitch Platform
- **Role**: Full-Stack Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Neon PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Zod, Tailwind CSS
- **Live URL**: https://pitchery.vercel.app/
- **Source**: https://github.com/SuyashSharma1710/pitchery
- **Overview**: Full-stack SaaS platform for startup pitch decks, founder profiles, discovery filtering, and direct investor outreach with server-side validation and relational data modeling.

### 4. Syncflow P.M.T. (2026) — Project Management Suite
- **Role**: Full-Stack Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Zustand, Tailwind CSS
- **Live URL**: https://syncflow-pmt.vercel.app/
- **Source**: https://github.com/SuyashSharma1710/syncflow_pmt
- **Overview**: Workspace and task management platform featuring nested projects, drag-and-drop Kanban boards, timeline tracking, full-text search, and optimistic UI updates with automatic error rollback.

### 5. FanOut (2025) — High-Concurrency Notification Pipeline
- **Role**: Full-Stack Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis, Tailwind CSS
- **Live URL**: https://fanout-nu.vercel.app/
- **Source**: https://github.com/SuyashSharma1710/fanout
- **Overview**: High-throughput notification fan-out engine simulating concurrent message broadcast across SMS, email, and push queues with rate-limiting and dead-letter queues.
